services.name: Pioneer Campground
services.desc: Our campground is an excellent stopping spot on the “best” route to Alaska. We have a total of 29 sites with 10 sites that offer full service and power hook-ups available at each stall, a washroom and shower facility are located in our beautiful log camp shelter, which has a lovely covered cooking/picnic area. We now offer internet access. A dumping station is located on the northeast corner of the campground. The campground opens on Mid-May with power service, and water available after the risk of freezing passes. The campground closes for the season mid-October weather permitting.
